title: The Self-Satisfied Doe
description: The Self-Satisfied Doe offers a sharp, sarcastic commentary on modern intimacy and emotional self-reliance. In a stark departure from my usual backgrounds, this canvas is filled with a hyper-colorful, chaotic pattern. In the center, a vulnerable pink doe, rendered with a fragile, glass-like quality, lies curled up like a wounded animal. While the surrounding background initially resembles a harmless, vibrant tapestry, a closer look reveals a dense scattering of adult toys and intimacy apparatuses. Through this visual subversion, I explore the bittersweet reality of self-satisfaction - meditating on the thin line between protective isolation and the heavy, independent armor we build while searching for love.
